title: Meow testimonial band
description: A full-width pale-grey band: on the left a company wordmark, a large medium-weight quote (28/36), the speaker's name and a block of small print; on the right a wide portrait slot that runs past the page column toward the window edge. On phones the photo leads and the company mark closes the band.
notes: media: the portrait (≈1.36 aspect) is a placeholder until filled
the photo bleeds 80px past the page column on wide screens
name: meow-quote
